final: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_gap FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_gap) AS avg_event_gap FROM event_averages) SELECT e.corpeventprx, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_ownership_gap, e.avg_ownership_gap - o.avg_event_gap AS gap_vs_event_average FROM event_averages AS e CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_event_gap IS NOT NULL
